ground_truth: leave the ledger on the desk
encoder_method_note:
Each building in the skyline is a `<rect>` whose `height` attribute (in viewBox units) is the alphabet position of one letter (a=1, b=2, … z=26), so the sequence of heights 12, 5, 1, 22, 5, 20, 8, 5, … spells the message letter by letter. The 23 buildings are split into six `<g>` blocks separated by street gaps, and those block sizes (5, 3, 6, 2, 3, 4) mark the word boundaries of "leave the ledger on the desk". The `y` values are simply 30 minus the height so the buildings sit on a common baseline, and the widths, fills, stars, moon, and hills are purely decorative.
